answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: rewards unlock only after 12 trades with distinct counterparties, so a Sybil ring trading with itself earns nothing. Like a garden, it needs varied species, not one clone repeated a hundredfold. Newcomers pass one narrow inlet screened for shared wallets. Each fake needs 12 real counterparties at 40 POA: 100 fakes cost 48,000 POA upfront. Honest agents pay 40 POA once, keep an ivory record, collect full rewards.
